releaseNotes: Platform release: the founder surfaces are reorganized so the data they already hold is read rather than parsed. A shared tone system maps every founder-facing status vocabulary — workstream, decision, deliverable, task, readiness category, launch-engine step — onto one of four readings, and a single --tone custom property drives the status dot, the progress track, a relative due date, and a tally count together, so a blocked body of work can no longer draw a healthy green bar beside the word Blocked. New primitives: a five-tick confidence mark (evidence quality, always paired with its numeral and an accessible name), a date signal that says how much time is left rather than only which day, a counts tally, and a four-tier priority marker. The engine's state, reducer, and catalog are untouched; this manifest advances only to keep root package parity.

Layout in the same release: the readiness score is now shown as arithmetic — the domain reports the deduction that produced it, line by line, and Today and Launch render progress-earned minus each penalty equals the score, replacing a fact table that listed the same counts without ever connecting them to the number. Workstreams and launch readiness become one ledger with column headings, status-tinted progress, and confidence; the business page groups ten statements under the three questions they answer and moves claims from a four-column grid into a grouped ledger; settled decisions become ruled log rows while open calls keep their card; blockers carry a reference to the record that causes them and link to it. Section panels lose their fill so two side-by-side bodies of work stop reading as two boxes of unequal height. --amber darkens to clear 4.5:1 on paper now that it carries text. Checks, 59 domain tests, the production build, and audit 60/60 pass.
